facts.fact: The ARPTC College president said in a 13 March 2025 speech that a ministerial order of 17 August 2024 provisionally entrusted the ARPTC with personal data protection and digital regulation, and that it will pursue awareness, controls and sanctions.
facts.system: Autorite de Regulation de la Poste et des Telecommunications du Congo (ARPTC)

systems.system: Autorite de Regulation de la Poste et des Telecommunications du Congo (ARPTC)

note: No ruling or count is stated; the duties are interim and by ministerial order rather than a law naming the body.
